verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents session recordings for debugging failures, in both rrweb DOM/interaction replays and MP4 video, and agents can be watched live. That covers the video-replay core of the story. Nothing shows per-step debug screenshots or an agent-level step-by-step action timeline; the screenshot formats cited belong to the scrape API, not run debugging. missing for 10: agent step-by-step action timeline, per-step screenshots of agent runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of replay debugging.
